title: Patricia M Probable NDE 4293
content: I went by ambulance to the emergency room at my local hospital, with a swollen stomach and in great pain. The doctor wanted to send me home, but my husband refused to take me and insisted they admit me. I lay all night with poison seeping into my body until the next morning, when I was air evacuated to another hospital, with doctors waiting to operate on me. I was cut open from my breast to my pelvic area to remove the sepsis that had gone all through my body. The doctors told my family that I would not make it and to call all the family in to say goodbye. I was on complete life support from the time I left the local hospital and for two weeks after my operation, which consisted of removal of half my colon and part of my liver. I also had the poison flushed from my system and blood transfusions. While I lay on my death bed knowing nothing of this world, I was on the beach with my mother, holding her hand and walking on the sand. There was a dolphin in the nearby water. The water seemed white and all else was this grey sort of color, but transparent too. My father was standing on a hill by a big building with lots of windows, but I couldn't see in the windows because they were blacked out. My mother and father looked the same, but different too. I need to say that my mother and father have been dead for a number of years. This place was so peaceful and wonderfully beautiful that I never wanted to leave. I was so happy. I remember everything was grey, white, and no movement whatsoever. I was lying on a pure white slab. There was a dolphin laying by my side while I was on this slab and it was smiling at me. There was a man standing at my head. He was trying to talk me into letting someone try something one more time, and I didn't want them to, I wanted to stay right where I was and not return. He talked me into letting them do this one more time, and I woke up on Mother's Day to find out I was in the hospital. I guess God wanted me to finish what he put me here to do.

arrival.other_being_detail: A man stood at her head and tried to persuade her to let someone try one more time; also a dolphin was present, smiling.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: She inferred a purpose: "God wanted me to finish what he put me here to do."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Sepsis/poison throughout body; major surgery removing half colon and part of liver; on complete life support.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Dolphin present; lying on a pure white slab; father near a big building with blacked-out windows.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE or tunnel described; experience begins in a beach environment with deceased parents, later shifts to lying on a white slab with a man persuading her to return, then awakening in hospital.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A dolphin accompanied her both in the water at the beach and later lying beside her on a pure white slab, smiling; a big building with many windows that were blacked out.

I was so happy."; "He was trying to talk me into letting someone try something one more time, and I didn't want them to, I wanted to stay right where I was and not return."; "I guess God wanted me to finish what he put me here to do."
